coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first. Direct retrieval of the current CMS Public Notices page failed in the web client; a CMS-domain fallback search found no newer qualifying termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or similar access-risk notice. Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were completed across hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis/oncology, primary care, rural/emergency services, ambulance, air medical, service restoration/reopening, and U.S. territories. No new qualifying development was identified in the bounded hourly window. Older or non-qualifying items were excluded, including previously announced maternity closures, non-U.S. service interruptions, proposals without concrete access effect, and older restoration plans.
